title: 粵語 · 普粵對照 From Mandarin
subtitle: What changes when you know Mandarin: core words, aspect, word order, questions and negation · written for Kotoba

groups.name: 係・唔・冇
groups.note: 係 hai6 = 是; 唔 m4 = 不; 冇 mou5 = 沒有 (有冇 = 有沒有). 冇 also negates past actions (我冇去 = 我沒去).

items.roman: ngo5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
keoi5 m4 hai6 hok6 saang1.
ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 cin2.
items.translation: I don't have any money today.

items.roman: nei5 jau5 mou5 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6?
ngo5 kam4 jat6 mou5 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
items.translation: I didn't go to work yesterday.

groups.name: 佢・嘅・啲
groups.note: 佢 keoi5 = 他/她/它 (佢哋 = 他們); 嘅 ge3 = 的; 啲 di1 = 些, and "a bit" after adjectives (快啲 = 快一點).

items.roman: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tung4 si6.
ni1 di1 hai6 bin1 go3 ge3 je5?
haang4 faai3 di1 laa1.
ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 do1 di1 si4 gaan3.
items.translation: I want a bit more time.

groups.name: 呢・嗰・邊
groups.note: 呢 ni1 = 這; 嗰 go2 = 那; 邊 bin1 = 哪. With a classifier: 呢個, 嗰本, 邊個 (= 誰 / 哪個). 呢度 / 嗰度 / 邊度 = 這裡 / 那裡 / 哪裡.

items.roman: ni1 go3 gei2 do1 cin2?
ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 bun2 syu1.
sai2 sau2 gaan1 hai2 bin1 dou6?
bin1 go3 daa2 din6 waa2 lei4?

groups.name: 喺
groups.note: 喺 hai2 = 在 for location (喺度 = 在這裡/在家). Don't confuse with 係 hai6 = 是.

items.roman: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2.
keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
nei5 lou5 sai3 hai2 m4 hai2 dou6?

groups.name: 食・飲・睇・講
groups.nameEn: 吃 · 喝 · 看 · 說
groups.note: 食 sik6 = 吃; 飲 jam2 = 喝; 睇 tai2 = 看; 講 gong2 = 說 (講嘢 = 說話). 話 waa6 = 說 when reporting (佢話… = 他說…).

items.roman: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1.
items.translation: I'd like a cup of coffee.

items.roman: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
items.translation: Let's go to the cinema tonight.

items.roman: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hou2 gui6.
nei5 gong2 maan6 di1 dak1 m4 dak1?
items.translation: Could you speak a bit slower?

groups.name: 行・企・瞓・着・搵・攞
groups.nameEn: 走 · 站 · 睡 · 穿 · 找 · 拿
groups.note: 行 haang4 = 走 (walk; 走 zau2 = leave!); 企 kei5 = 站; 瞓 fan3 = 睡; 着 zoek3 = 穿; 搵 wan2 = 找; 攞 lo2 = 拿.

items.roman: ngo5 haang4 lou6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 dou6, co5 dai1 laa1.
items.translation: Don't just stand there, sit down.

items.roman: ngo5 kam4 maan5 hou2 je6 sin1 fan3.
items.translation: I went to bed very late last night.

items.roman: gam1 jat6 dung3, zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1.
items.translation: It's cold today, wear another layer.
items.mandarin: 今天冷，多穿一件衣服吧。

items.roman: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2.
bong1 ngo5 lo2 go2 go3 doi2.

groups.name: 畀
groups.note: 畀 bei2 = 給. Word order differs: 畀本書我 = 給我一本書 — the thing comes before the person.

items.roman: bei2 bun2 syu1 ngo5.
ngo5 bei2 zo2 cin2 keoi5 laa3.
items.translation: I've already given him the money.

items.roman: keoi5 bei2 jan4 naau6.

groups.name: 咗・緊・過
groups.note: V咗 zo2 = V了 (completed); V緊 gan2 = 在V (in progress); V過 gwo3 = V過 (experience) — 緊 comes after the verb, unlike 在.

items.roman: ngo5 maai5 zo2 san1 din6 waa2.
keoi5 sik6 gan2 faan6.
nei5 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2 mei6?
ngo5 zou6 gan2 je5, dang2 zan6 zoi3 king1.

groups.name: 未・仲
groups.note: 未 mei6 = 還沒 (V咗未？ = V了沒有？); 仲 zung6 = 還 (仲未 = 還沒).

items.roman: nei5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 mei6?
ngo5 zung6 mei6 sik6 zou2 caan1.
keoi5 zung6 hai2 dou6.

groups.name: 晒・埋・返・開
groups.note: V晒 saai3 = all of it (食晒 = 吃光); V埋 maai4 = also / finish off (做埋 = 也做 / 做完); V返 faan1 = back, again (攞返 = 拿回); V開 hoi1 = usually, habitually (用開 = 平常用的).

items.roman: keoi5 sik6 saai3 di1 daan6 gou1.
nei5 zou6 maai4 ni1 joeng6 sin1 zau2 laa1.
items.translation: Finish this one too before you go.
items.mandarin: 你把這個也做完再走吧。

items.roman: gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 baa2 ze1.
items.translation: Remember to take the umbrella back.

items.roman: ngo5 jung6 hoi1 ni1 zek3 paai4 zi2.
items.translation: This is the brand I usually use.

groups.name: V先
groups.note: 先 sin1 goes after the verb phrase: 你行先 = 你先走.

items.roman: nei5 haang4 sin1, ngo5 ci4 di1 lei4.
items.translation: You go first, I'll come a bit later.

items.roman: sik6 zo2 faan6 sin1 laa1.
ngo5 nam2 haa5 sin1.
items.translation: Let me think about it first.

groups.name: A 形容詞 過 B
groups.nameEn: A 比 B 形容詞
groups.note: Comparison: 佢高過我 = 他比我高. "Much more": 高好多; "a bit more": 高少少.

items.roman: keoi5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5.
gam1 jat6 jit6 gwo3 kam4 jat6 hou2 do1.
items.translation: Today is much hotter than yesterday.

items.roman: daap3 dei6 tit3 faai3 gwo3 daap3 baa1 si2.
items.translation: Taking the MTR is faster than the bus.

groups.name: V多啲・V少啲
groups.note: "More / less" comes after the verb: 食多啲 = 多吃一點, 講少兩句 = 少說兩句.

items.roman: sik6 do1 di1 coi3 laa1.
nei5 gong2 siu2 loeng5 geoi3 laa1.
items.translation: Say a bit less, will you.

items.roman: fan3 do1 zan6 laa1.

groups.name: 乜嘢・點・幾時・點解・幾多
groups.nameEn: 什麼 · 怎麼 · 什麼時候 · 為什麼 · 多少
groups.note: 乜嘢/咩 mat1 je5/me1 = 什麼; 點 dim2 = 怎麼; 幾時 gei2 si4 = 什麼時候; 點解 dim2 gaai2 = 為什麼; 幾多 gei2 do1 = 多少.

items.roman: nei5 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5?
heoi3 gei1 coeng4 dim2 heoi3?
items.translation: How do I get to the airport?

items.roman: nei5 gei2 si4 faan1 lei4?
dim2 gaai2 nei5 m4 lei4?
ni1 dou6 jau5 gei2 do1 jan4?

groups.name: V唔V・得唔得
groups.note: Yes/no questions are usually V唔V (去唔去 = 去不去) or 得唔得 (可以嗎). Two-syllable verbs: 鍾唔鍾意, 可唔可以.

items.roman: nei5 heoi3 m4 heoi3?
nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6?
ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 co5 ni1 dou6?
ting1 jat6 sin1 gaau1, dak1 m4 dak1?
items.translation: Can I hand it in tomorrow?

groups.name: 唔好・唔使・咪
groups.note: 唔好 m4 hou2 = 別/不要; 唔使 m4 sai2 = 不用; 咪 mai5 = 別 (casual).

items.roman: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1.
m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
items.translation: You're welcome / no need to be polite.

items.roman: mai5 juk1!

groups.name: 識・會・得
groups.note: 識 sik1 = 會 (know how to); 會 wui5 = 會 (will); V得 = can (食得 = 可以吃); V唔到 = can't manage to.

items.roman: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2?
ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
ni1 di1 je5 sik6 dak1 m4 dak1 gaa3?
ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 nei5 gong2 mat1.
items.translation: I don't understand what you're saying.

groups.name: 個・隻・部・架・間・條・張
groups.note: Many classifiers differ from Mandarin: 部 bou6 for phones and machines, 架 gaa3 for vehicles, 間 gaan1 for shops and rooms, 隻 zek3 for many animals and some objects. A classifier + noun alone can mean "the": 部電話壞咗 = 那部手機壞了.

items.roman: bou6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2.
ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gaa3 san1 ce1.
items.translation: I want to buy a new car.

items.roman: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 ceot1 meng2.
ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 loeng5 zek3 maau1.
items.translation: I have two cats at home.

items.roman: ze3 tiu4 bat1 lei4 jung6 haa5.
items.translation: Lend me a pen for a sec.
